test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Vishnu and family __are looking around into__ the possibility of moving to Canada.
solution:
The correct answer is: **are looking into**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Remove the preposition '**around**' to correct the sentence.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given phrasal verbs.
 
 
• "**Looking around**" means going through a place in order to see what is there: to explore a place.
 
• "Looking into" means trying to find out about something.
 
• "Looking upto" means to respect and admire someone.
 
 
 
• The sentence is talking about a possibility, so "**looking into**" should be used.
 
• We cannot use two prepositions (around and into) simultaneously in a single sentence. It doesn't make any sense.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Vishnu and his family are considering relocating to Canada.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**, which can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

**Corrected sentence:** *Vishnu and family are looking into the possibility of moving to Canada.*
